critical_bug_n8n_postgresql.title: PostgreSQL LIKE is accent-sensitive - most searches for accented products FAIL
critical_bug_n8n_postgresql.description: The production workflow uses PostgreSQL LIKE for product search. The n8n pre-processing node strips accents (NFD normalization) from the customer message. When a customer types 'champinones', the SQL does: `LOWER(name) LIKE '%champinones%'`. But the DB stores 'Champiñones enteros' (with ñ). PostgreSQL LIKE is accent-sensitive by default, so 'ñ' !== 'n' and the search FAILS.
critical_bug_n8n_postgresql.impact: ANY product with accents (ñ, á, é, í, ó, ú) in its name is UNFINDABLE via the automatic PostgreSQL search when the customer types the unaccented version. This affects dozens of products.
critical_bug_n8n_postgresql.why_vercel_api_works: The Vercel API normalizes both the search term AND the product name with `normalizeAccents()` BEFORE comparing: `normalizeAccents('Champiñones enteros')` = 'champinones enteros'. Then `'champinones enteros'.includes('champinones')` = TRUE.
critical_bug_n8n_postgresql.fix: Migrate the search node to use the Vercel API instead of PostgreSQL. The API already has proper accent-insensitive matching built in.

gaps_analysis.title: Stop words collapse breaks singular/plural matching
gaps_analysis.description: When search has articles like 'las'/'los'/'un'/'unas', the stop word is stripped leaving a single word. But the single-word path doesn't check singular/plural variants, causing searches like 'las naranjas' to return 0 while 'naranjas' returns 2.
gaps_analysis.root_cause: In productMatchesSearch(), the single-word check `if (words.length === 1)` uses the original word directly with includes() instead of checking its singular/plural variants.
gaps_analysis.fix: Add variant checking in the single-word path: check if ANY variant of the word is in the name/description.

gaps_analysis.title: No typo tolerance
gaps_analysis.description: Common misspellings or typos return zero results. 'arbeja' (typo for 'arveja') returns 0. No Levenshtein distance or fuzzy matching.
gaps_analysis.fix: Add Levenshtein distance matching or fuzzy search for close matches (threshold: 1-2 edits). Or add a synonym dictionary.

gaps_analysis.title: No regional synonym handling
gaps_analysis.description: 'calabaza' returns 0 while 'auyama' (Colombian term) returns 1 result. Customers might use different regional names.
gaps_analysis.fix: Add a synonyms/mappings dictionary: {'calabaza': 'auyama', 'patatas': 'papas', etc.} applied before search or within the matching logic.

gaps_analysis.title: False positives from substring matching without word boundaries
gaps_analysis.description: Short substrings in longer words cause false positives. 'piña'→'Espinaca', 'papa'→'Papaya', 'mora'→'morada'. The productMatchesSearch function uses includes() without word boundaries.
gaps_analysis.fix: Use word boundary regex (\b) for matching instead of includes(), or ensure minimum match ratio of 60%+.

gaps_analysis.title: n8n workflow does NOT use the Vercel API for product search
gaps_analysis.description: The production workflow (YKd9FQHLCvUiePAf) uses PostgreSQL direct queries with SQL LIKE for '3. Búsqueda Automática Productos', bypassing the more sophisticated Vercel API search with accent-insensitive matching, scoring, and plural handling.
gaps_analysis.impact: CRITICAL: SQL LIKE is accent-sensitive. The n8n pre-processing strips accents from customer messages. Combined, search terms like 'champinones' will NEVER match database products like 'Champiñones enteros' because 'ñ' !== 'n' for PostgreSQL LIKE. This makes ~30%+ of products unfindable through the automatic search path. The Vercel API solves this by normalizing accents before comparison.
gaps_analysis.fix: Migrate the search node to use the Vercel API (HTTP Request node) instead of PostgreSQL query. Use: GET /api/agent/products?search={{termino}}&limit=10&active_only=true with x-agent-key header.

gaps_analysis.title: Missing products in catalog
gaps_analysis.description: 'yuca' returns 0 results - no yuca product exists. 'calabaza' exists as 'auyama' (regional naming).
gaps_analysis.fix: Ensure catalog coverage for commonly requested products, or add product aliases/redirects.

gaps_analysis.title: Detailed search scoring not exposed to n8n workflow
gaps_analysis.description: The Vercel API returns _searchScore but the workflow doesn't use it for ranking or filtering. The PostgreSQL query has a simpler priority system.
gaps_analysis.fix: When using the Vercel API, pass _searchScore to the AI context so the agent can evaluate relevance.

gaps_analysis.title: Missing new AGENT_OPS_API_KEY in n8n tools
gaps_analysis.description: The lab workflow (lab-fix-api-key.json) shows that TOOL_BuscarProductos is designed to use the Vercel API with x-agent-key, but it has a placeholder 'CONFIGURAR_AQUI_NUEVA_AGENT_OPS_API_KEY'. The old key (4d8cfb14fba5451c875ac515fa047f9b) still works but should be configured properly in the production workflow.
gaps_analysis.fix: Configure the actual AGENT_OPS_API_KEY in the production workflow's n8n credentials or environment variables.

recommendations.action: Migrate '3. Búsqueda Automática Productos' from PostgreSQL to Vercel API
recommendations.details: Replace the PostgreSQL query node with an HTTP Request node calling GET /api/agent/products?search={{terminoBusqueda}}&limit=10&active_only=true with x-agent-key header. This enables accent-insensitive matching, proper plural handling, and relevance scoring.
recommendations.effort: Medium - swap node type and adjust response parsing in '4. Merge Datos + Productos'

recommendations.action: Fix GAP-1: Stop word handling in single-word path
recommendations.details: In products/route.ts, modify the single-word check to use getSingularPluralVariants() before checking includes(). Currently words.length === 1 path doesn't check variants.
recommendations.code_change: Change `if (normalizedName.includes(words[0]))` to check each variant of words[0]

recommendations.action: Add synonym dictionary for regional terms
recommendations.details: Implement a synonym map in the API route.ts: 'calabaza'→'auyama', 'patatas'→'papas', 'elote'→'maíz', 'judías'→'habichuela'. Apply before productMatchesSearch.
recommendations.effort: Low - add a const SYNONYMS map and normalize search term

recommendations.action: Add word boundary enforcement for short substrings
recommendations.details: For words shorter than 5 characters, use word boundary regex instead of includes() to avoid false positives like 'piña'→'Espinaca'. Consider minimum match ratio.
recommendations.effort: Medium - requires testing to avoid breaking valid matches

workflow_search_flow.description: How the PRODUCCION workflow searches for products in two stages

stage_1_automatic.input: terminoBusqueda (from pre-processing, with stop words stripped, plurals normalized)
stage_1_automatic.singularization: Removes trailing 'es' or 's' from search term
stage_1_automatic.sql_filter: is_active = true, ILIKE matching on name/category/description
stage_1_automatic.sort: CASE match_priority (1: name starts with, 2: category, 3: name contains, 4: description)

stage_2_ai_fallback.trigger: When AI decides auto-search results don't match customer request
stage_2_ai_fallback.sql_filter: is_active=true, price>0, stock>0, excludes specific product
stage_2_ai_fallback.note: This tool currently uses different Postgres credentials ('Postgres account' vs main 'Mi PostgreSQL Docker')
